# Debrief: Argo CD, Prometheus

These clips cover Argo CD practices, including avoiding imperative app creation, fast pull request previews using a real Argo CD instance, and using the Argo CD API for troubleshooting; Prometheus appears only in passing. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 8:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=526s); [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s); [The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 15:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=924s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Creating Argo CD applications through a custom CLI that generates manifests and applies them without storing anything in Git is flagged as an anti-pattern that undermines a declarative GitOps setup. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 8:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=526s))
2. Rendering pull request previews with a real Argo CD instance gives accurate diffs matching production; one team reports around 5 seconds for a repository of roughly 1,000 applications using self-hosted runners. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s); [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 5:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=326s))
3. Argo CD's API exposes application logs, Kubernetes events, and live versus desired state, which speakers used to reduce data silos across tools like Prometheus-metric dashboards and feed an LLM for troubleshooting. ([The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 15:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=924s))

## Action items

- [ ] Audit how Argo CD applications get created in your organization and check whether any scripts or CLIs apply manifests to Argo CD without committing them to Git. ([Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 8:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=526s))
- [ ] Try a pull request preview workflow that renders manifests with a real Argo CD instance, and scope rendering to only the applications affected by each change. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 5:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=326s); [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 16:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=976s))
- [ ] Evaluate a namespace-scoped, slimmed-down Argo CD install, removing cluster roles and unneeded components, as the lockdown approach one team used alongside their preview runners. ([Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s))

## Watch together (6 min)

1. [Declarative...ish? Fixing Hidden Argo CD Pitfalls in Your GitOps Setup · 8:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfVQj4Oa3z0&t=526s) (1:19), Regina Voloshin: Names an imperative anti-pattern that breaks GitOps with Argo CD.
2. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 10:49](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=649s) (1:19), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Shows 5-second previews and a locked-down Argo CD setup.
3. [Argo CD: Previewing Pull Request Changes in SECONDS! · 16:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcajag5di68&t=976s) (1:19), Dag Bjerre Andersen, Sergey Shevchenko: Explains narrowing rendering scope to only changed applications.
4. [The 10x DevOps Engineer’s Toolkit: Argo CD + AI-Driven MCP Automation · 15:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iC15zeOLZQA&t=924s) (2:27), Alexander Matyushentsev, Leonardo Luz Almeida: Mentions Prometheus metrics silos and using Argo CD API for troubleshooting.
